items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: Once you were talking with Tom about you and Fats Waller

ctx.x: Frank, uh-huh. Once you were talking with Tom about you and Fats Waller and J. P. Johnson going to some club or some little spot and all three of you playing with Fats hitting a chord and taking off and then somebody else picking up on it. Do you recall what club that was?
